about: Single source of truth for conformance case CLASSIFICATION — how a conformance/cases/<name>/ dir maps to a runner, and which families a wasm host skips. Consumers: hosts/conformance-shared/index.ts (both TS hosts, transitively) and hosts/rust/build.rs (parsed at build time via serde_json). The Zig runner (src/conformance_tests.zig) is the REFERENCE and classifies natively — it mirrors this file rather than reading it. Editing a family/marker/precedence here must keep those three consumers in agreement (the classifier audits + build.rs dead-family check are the drift net).

wasmHostSkipFamilies.label: lowering-*
wasmHostSkipFamilies.reason: exercises the Zig-side lowering registry + test/identity-v1 hook; a wasm host (web/rust) drives sjon.wasm, which has no Zig-side registry (mirrors the plugin-exec skip shape)

wasmHostSkipFamilies.label: too-many-keys
wasmHostSkipFamilies.reason: validateDocument drops the errored plugin from the schema, so (big …) becomes unknown_form on top of the manifest-phase too_many_keys; the legacy pre-compose path keeps the truncated plugin
